verdict.rationale: The evidence includes content from a public GitHub repository at github.com/supabase/auth, and the self-hosting docs say users can run their own Supabase, so the source appears readable. Nothing in the pack names the license, so the 'open license' part of the story is unproven. missing for 10: explicit license identification (e.g., MIT/Apache), first-party statement that Auth is open source, independent corroboration of license terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
